replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: Public aggregate revenue values can bound fiscal-scale placeholder discussion.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: Fiscal placeholders now link to loaded ATO and Budget receipt scale anchors.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: The fiscal trajectory remains a placeholder; no CARSF revenue pathway, fiscal incidence, Treasury modelling, or PBO costing is created.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: The field remains blocked until safe public extraction and authorised welfare or repayment evidence are available.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: No Build 31 public HELP value was loaded; the HELP threshold source remains future-only.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: HELP repayment pressure remains placeholder-only and cannot estimate individual repayment pressure.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: Public wage and casual-loading anchors can narrow the visible labour-cost placeholder context.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: The HLE labour-cost placeholder can be bounded by loaded wage and casual-loading public anchors.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: The HLE method remains unresolved and does not model actual human labour equivalents.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: A public wage threshold is available as a direct aggregate anchor for OPFTE placeholder review.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: The OPFTE wage placeholder is now linked to loaded public hourly and weekly national minimum wage anchors.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: OPFTE remains a placeholder benchmark; occupation mix, sector labour requirements, and schedule authority methods remain unresolved.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: Public tax aggregates provide context for PAYG erosion placeholder review.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: PAYG erosion placeholders now reference loaded public tax aggregate context.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: Public tax totals do not identify AI-related PAYG erosion, taxpayer behaviour, or CARSF revenue.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: The field remains a visible future replacement candidate only.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: No Build 31 public state payroll threshold value was loaded; the source remains future-only.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: State payroll tax pressure remains placeholder-only and does not provide state tax advice or employer incidence.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: Public wage thresholds can narrow the QLC wage-anchor placeholder context.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: The QLC wage component can be bounded by loaded public wage thresholds.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: QLC weighting remains a realistic placeholder and does not establish task allocation, sector labour mix, or tax treatment.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: Public wage anchors provide limited context for sector schedule placeholder review.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: Loaded wage anchors give sector-schedule placeholders labour-cost context.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: ABS labour source remains not loaded and sector schedules are not official rankings, calibrated schedules, or legal attribution rules.

replacement_decisions.what_can_now_be_said: A public superannuation guarantee rate is available as a direct aggregate anchor for payment-interaction placeholder review.
replacement_decisions.what_changed: The superannuation guarantee placeholder now links to a loaded public rate setting.
replacement_decisions.what_did_not_change: The field does not estimate individual superannuation, payroll, employer behaviour, or ATO guidance.
